Think you understand
banking?
Here are two
things you should
know!
A debit card
uses money directly
from your bank
account.
A credit card
lets you borrow
money and pay
it back later.
A checking account
is for everyday
spending,
like paying bills
and buying groceries.
A savings account
is where you
keep money and
earn interest.
Debit means your
money.
Credit means borrowed
money.
Checking means spending.
Savings means keeping
money.
